description:
Browser where your favorite apps won't get buried in tabs.


🍪 Biscuit Release Note

💪🏻Improvements
- Updated Electron to 43.8.6 with upstream Chromium and V8 fixes.
- Improved progress reporting for downloads with unknown sizes.

🐞Bug
- Fixed native module packaging for 32-bit Windows.
- Prevented simultaneous downloads with the same file name from overwriting each other.
- Fixed incorrect download status after interrupted connections.
- Fixed errors when closing a tab or window during downloads, or closing Biscuit immediately after startup.
